facts:
## CELL FACTS

Cell 水_比肩 (Water carrying The Twin). Persona The Twin (比肩). Definition line: "Same nature, same register, the standard you hold yourself to". Keyword Independence, charge steady, poles catalyst Self-trust / friction Isolation. Family function: Body. Cost dimension: the standard held to oneself; company that truly matches is rare. Arena: mirrors, stride, equal measure, walking beside. Classical portrait: same nature, same register; the standard held to oneself; self-reliance that can wall others out. Ruled domains: Peers, Independence, Self-reliance. Sibling (other polarity of the family): 劫财.
Element arena: Water (depth, current, tide, rain, spring, flow). dm_element (which core reads this cell): Water. structural_interaction seed: "Depth amplifying depth — perceptual intelligence running without form".
- k2_overview: "Your Water moves as the Twin: a current that keeps its own channel while running beside others. You match people without merging into them, fluent in company, private in depth. Two rivers to the same sea is your model of friendship: shared direction, separate water, and no argument about whose current is whose."
- k2_functional: "Your energy runs in currents: even output for weeks, then a quiet season to refill the source."
- adj_chips: {"friction":["Cold-running","Isolated","Impenetrable"],"catalyst":"[REDACTED: the words under test]"}
- k2_domain_readings: {"Peers":"Your peers are parallel currents: fellow travelers heading the same direction by different beds. You collect companions across every landscape you cross. Keep a few for the whole length of the river, not just the pretty stretches.","Independence":"Water independence is having your own source: income, opinions, and inner weather that no one else controls upstream. Protect the headwaters. Everything else about you can flex.","Self-reliance":"You route around what others need rescuing from, so smoothly that nobody notices there was an obstacle. Occasionally say the obstacle out loud. Even self-sufficient rivers deserve witnesses."}
- fn_reading.catalyst.ledger (three rows, index-aligned to adj_chips.catalyst; authored order is significance order):
  - row 0: [REDACTED: the target row]
  - row 1: [REDACTED: the target row]
  - row 2: [REDACTED: the target row]
- Sibling cell 水_劫财 chips (nothing you write may fit the sibling): {"catalyst":["Competitive","Unafraid","Agile"],"friction":["Undermining","Envious","Slippery"]}
- Sibling cell 水_劫财 catalyst row 0 drive passage, for the sibling test on the tension (this row must name a different either-or): "Rivalry wakes you up. A competitor in the water and your stroke sharpens, your pace lifts, and the race becomes the point of the day. You measure yourself against real people, openly, and you move faster for it than any plan could make you."

Core element Water, energy element Water. Law: Water and Water are the same element (the self pair). Relative to the core the energy is the self, so Water is this core's Body. No chart is attached to this batch: the cell is written for every chart with a Water core that shows Water on the catalyst pole, so no percentage and no state of one chart appears in any value. The catalyst pole of Water as the Body is the Underfueled band's case (the core burns more than it takes in); tone by pole: compliment. Rows: row 0, row 1, row 2, each with its three angles (drive, cost_self, cost_others: the drive, the cost to the reader, the cost to others; the app shows one angle per row by position rotation, so each passage must stand alone); one chip per row, written once and copied byte-identical onto the row's three fields. The pair cell 水_水's definition and advice for this pole are rewritten in the same batch (the pair skeleton) and are withheld here; no four-word run may be shared with them, so keep every phrase the ledger's own.
